principle: The Bible Theatre requires complete narrative coverage, NOT painting coverage. Many episodes share paintings or have no painting; new-source effort weighted to the New Testament.

theologyRules: No artwork must fabricate literal geography for Revelation visions
A painting depicting a later narrative moment must never caption an earlier moment as exact
The same John 21 commissioned-Peter event may be represented via one asset across overlapping subjects
Retain previous user selections and protect against artist-style exclusions and wrong object substitutes

subjects.reuseOrVisualNotes: Reuse the Flood/Noah canonical artwork if pictorially relevant; rainbow covenant may stand as text/icon; no independent hunt.
